verdict.rationale: Gide explicitly documents 11 own offices across multiple countries (Algiers, Brussels, Casablanca, Dakar, Istanbul, London, New York, Paris, Shanghai, Tunis, Warsaw), with long-established presences (40 years in New York, 20 in London) plus stated 'close relationships with top law firms across the world' for reach beyond its own network. Missing for 10: independent verification of office capabilities per jurisdiction and detail on how local qualified practices operate versus referral partners.
